profile_text.body:
Figma describes itself as "the collaborative canvas for design, code, and AI" where teams move from concept to production in a single workspace. The company positions design, code, and AI as integrated elements of its platform, emphasizing that teammates and AI agents work in the same space with shared context to generate design directions, refine work, and align together.

Figma's AI offering, Figma AI, falls within the image and graphic design category and includes auto-layout, content generation, and design system governance capabilities. The company is a public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Francisco, trading under the ticker FIG.
